emotional_tone: Authoritative, hyper-efficient, command-center, premium tech, mysterious yet clear

rules: CRITICAL: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, or Syne
Apply 'tracking-tight' or 'tracking-tighter' to all headings above text-2xl
Use 'uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs' for overlines, labels, and table headers
Use JetBrains Mono for metrics, code snippets, AI audit scores, and deployment statuses

spacing_and_layout.marketing_page: Generous padding (p-16 to p-32). Use Mode A 'Tetris' Bento Grid for feature showcases. Never use basic symmetric Bootstrap-style columns.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Mode B 'Control Room' Grid. Dense and compact (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize 1px solid borders to define structure without shadows. Go cardless where possible by using border-collapse layout styles.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Strictly 'rounded-sm' (4px) or 'rounded-none' for a sharp, technical 'operating system' aesthetic.

surface_strategies.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10. Sticky positioning z-50.
surface_strategies.dashboard_panels: Grid Borders: flat backgrounds (#0A0A0A) with sharp 1px borders (border-white/10). Remove default heavy shadows.
surface_strategies.buttons_and_ctas: High contrast minimal. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200. Secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10.

animation_and_motion.general: Minimalist micro-interactions. Snappy and immediate. No slow, decorative fades.
animation_and_motion.hover_states: CRITICAL: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
animation_and_motion.page_transitions: Use subtle staggered entrances for list items and kanban cards.

component_instructions.marketing: Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. Build custom asymmetrical layouts. Overlay hero images with a maximum of bg-black/40 (or a gradient) so the asset remains visible.
component_instructions.dashboard_crm: Use Shadcn UI extensively (Tables, Select, Dialogs, Dropdowns) but HEAVILY customize them. Strip default styles to match the 'cardless' technical aesthetic. Kanban board should be a horizontal scroll container with thin, strict vertical columns.
component_instructions.ai_audit: Use circular progress components or dense progress bars with 'JetBrains Mono' numeric scores colored by status (Red, Yellow, Green).

image_urls.description: Pure black background with subtle texture for landing page hero overlay
Close-up of a maze texture for website audit and CRM feature sections
Dramatic modern glass building reflecting evening sky - for Agency Scale / About sections
Grayscale portrait for user avatar or testimonials
Professional man in dark suit for CRM contact lead avatar
Tech company logo on dark background for integrations and sponsor marquees
Dark blue abstract mesh gradient for subtle deployment card highlights

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over images for text-heavy areas; utilize backdrop-blur or gradient masks.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='kanban-column-contacted'). Use kebab-case and role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` is utilized for crisp, technical icons matching the UI density.
For the Landing Page: Implement pure HTML/Tailwind. Create an asymmetric Bento Grid for features, an immersive dark hero section, and avoid typical centered cards.
For the Dashboard UI: Build a command-center layout (sidebar nav + dense top header). Make heavy use of 1px border grids and monochrome colors with functional accents (Red/Yellow/Green) for statuses.
For CRM Kanban: Create a horizontally scrollable container with vertical columns, styled with thin borders and minimal padding.
For the AI Audit Page: Display technical metrics clearly using the mono font (JetBrains Mono). Implement a Vercel-style deployment list with clean, flat rows.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT introduce standard generic blue or purple gradients. Use only the deep slate blacks, whites, and provided functional colors.
Never use placeholder images from dummy services. Only use the provided image URLs.
